info.title: Bingold Admin API
info.description: API for Bingold Admin Panel (RBAC, Blogs, News) and the BingoPay merchant payment layer on top of BinGold.

tags.name: BingoPay - Wallet
tags.description: Balance / ledger / withdraw (forwards the BinGold token)

tags.name: BingoPay - Merchant
tags.description: Vendor self-service: onboarding, QR, KYC, dashboard, withdraw

tags.name: BingoPay - Pay
tags.description: Customer QR payment flow: resolve, quote, confirm

tags.name: BingoPay Admin - Vendors
tags.description: Admin: vendor onboarding, approval, KYC (online + offline)

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: Bearer token. Admin endpoints: the admin JWT. BingoPay customer/merchant endpoints: the user's BinGold session token. Format: **Bearer <token>**

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Global API key (PDA_API_KEY). Required on every endpoint except the public webhook.

post.summary: Sumsub KYC webhook (authenticated by x-payload-digest HMAC; no api-key/JWT)
Check if an email already has a BinGold account (and sync local mapping if it does)
Register a new customer in BinGold (signup) and create local mapping
Login via BinGold; returns BinGold tokens + local profile, otpRequired flag
Get wallet balance from BinGold (requires BinGold token)

get.summary: Get the BinGold user profile (requires BinGold token)

post.summary: Wallet ledger / transaction history (deposits, withdrawals, buys)
Apply to become a merchant (idempotent). Creates the vendor profile.
Update settle_coin / accepted_coins and safe business fields
Create a payment QR (static = open/fixed, dynamic = per-charge)
Enable/disable one of my QR codes
Submit offline KYC documents (multipart; one file per type)
List my submitted KYC documents + statuses
Sales dashboard: totals + earnings by coin (today and overall)

get.summary: Resolve a scanned QR to merchant info + accepted coins

post.summary: Resolve a QR (uuid in body) to merchant info + accepted coins
Quote: how much payCoin is needed (USD-based conversion to merchant settle coin)
Confirm + execute payment. Records the txn and calls the BinGold transfer adapter (transferPending=true until BINGOLD_TRANSFER_PATH is set).
Check an email against BinGold (user_exists) and persist the mapping if it exists
Onboard a vendor (admin). Provide user_id OR email/phone + business details.
Start Sumsub (online) KYC; returns applicant_id + WebSDK access_token
Submit offline KYC documents for a vendor (multipart). vendor_id as form field.
List offline KYC documents for a vendor
Create a payment QR for a vendor (admin)
Create a settlement batch for a vendor
